headline: Flat sales and thin profit after one-off tax charge
summary_short: CNH's Q3 2026 consolidated revenue was about $4.35 billion, roughly flat y/y, with diluted EPS of $0.02 and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.16.
summary_long: Net sales of Industrial Activities were about $3.68 billion, essentially unchanged y/y. Net income was $35 million, down 48%. Reported coverage cites $109 million of pre-tax tariff refunds and a $156 million non-cash valuation allowance on Brazilian Financial Services deferred tax assets. CNH separately agreed to sell 70% of its Construction Equipment business to Kobelco at a $1 billion enterprise value.
